current.changeLog:
FRONT LINE, PROPERLY
A Front Line battle is several tanks in one game, and the site now records it as
one battle with the totals of every tank you drove - plus a per-tank breakdown
showing what each one earned and what it cost. Battles you leave early are
recovered from the game server, so nothing is lost.

previous.changeLog: The Tier XI skill tree bar now shows the next locked upgrades one step ahead. Each next chip links to the unlocked skill it builds on.

current.changeLog:
Allow Fallthrough setting (off by default, replaces Exclude Elite System): when on, the bar skips a disabled mode and shows the next available mode in priority order, instead of hiding.
The Tier XI skill-tree bar draws a one-parent, three-child upgrade node as a T-branch — two children inline and the third on a branch below — instead of a misleading straight chain.
Fixed issues that appeared with the introduction of LF.

previous.changeLog: added minimap overlay displaying most possible team movements during countdown, top damage positions, top assisted damage positions for light tanks

current.changeLog: dynamically display top damage and spotting positions so mid game points don't appear in the early game.
